title: Trusted Voices: How Clinicians Can Help Shape Safer Communities
summary: Healthcare professionals are among the most trusted voices in society. Through routine safety conversations, risk identification, and community partnerships, clinicians can play an important role in gun violence prevention and building safer communities. This discussion explores how healthcare organizations are helping shift the focus from responding to violence toward preventing it.
